raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Bug

HiSparse + speculative decoding + PD disaggregation on a `--pp-size > 1` prefill fails on the first request: every non-last pipeline stage raises

```
ValueError: HiSparse spec PD transfer requires an appended device-only draft KV buffer
```

inside `send_kvcache` (mooncake), killing that stage's transfer thread. All subsequent PD requests hang at 0 completions while `/health` stays 200.

## When it happens

Mooncake PD with a spec-decoding decode engine and hisparse. Only the last prefill PP stage owns a draft runner, so non-last stages register `num_draft_entries = 0`; `send_kvcache` derives the host-backed vs device-only boundary in the receiver's `dst_kv_ptrs` from the local stage count and raises when it is 0. Any model whose weights exceed one node's HBM at the target TP forces PP>1 on the prefill (GLM-5.3 FP8 at TP8: 88.5 GB/GPU > 80 GB HBM), so production-shaped topologies hit this on the first request. The current CI does not reach this path (the hisparse PD test runs PP=1 with a dense prefill and no spec), and this is the destination-side boundary suggested during #37771 review.

## Fix

The decode receiver ships its registered draft-entry count over the mooncake registration wire (one field appended after `kv_item_lens`; absent for peers that predate it), and `send_kvcache` takes the host-backed/device-only boundary from the destination's registration, falling back to the local count when the field is absent. Old peers keep the current behavior exactly.

## Verification

- Unit tests (`test_disaggregation_wire.py`): a non-last PP stage takes the boundary from the destination registration and transfers only its target span; a pre-field peer still raises the loud error; the registration round-trips the count and parses `None` when the field is absent. All pass on this branch; the new tests fail on current main (`AttributeError` / `TypeError`), i.e. they detect the bug.
- E2E (v0.5.22-based tree carrying the same diff; GLM-5.3 FP8 on 4x H100; prefill TP8xPP2+CP8, decode TP16+DP16+EAGLE 3/1/4, hisparse): the hang reproduced before the fix (the raise appears on the non-last stage only, first request); with the fix the stack serves — 128k-context needle retrieval 5/5, no raise on any stage.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit)
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests)
- [ ] Update documentations according to the [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations) (no user-facing flag or behavior change)
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to the [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) (lossless 128k needle gate 5/5; no throughput claim)
- [x] Follow the [SGLang code style guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance)

+    def test_non_last_pp_stage_takes_boundary_from_destination(self):
+        """A PP stage with no draft runner must use the receiver's boundary.
+
+        Only the last prefill PP stage owns a draft runner, so a non-last
+        stage registers num_draft_entries=0 while the destination's
+        registration still appends draft buffers.
+        """
+        manager = object.__new__(MooncakeKVManager)
+        manager.kv_args = SimpleNamespace(
+            mla_compression_ratios=None,
+            prefill_start_layer=0,
+            prefill_end_layer=2,
+            kv_data_ptrs=[1000, 2000],
+            kv_item_lens=[100, 100],
+            kv_layer_ids=[],
+            num_draft_entries=0,
+        )
+        manager.is_mla_backend = True
+        manager.is_hybrid_mla_backend = False
+        manager.enable_custom_mem_pool = False
+        manager.max_transfer_batch_indices = 0
+        manager.pp_size = 2
+        manager._transfer_data = Mock(return_value=0)
+        # Decode registered 4 target entries plus 1 draft entry.
+        dst_ptrs = [10000, 20000, 30000, 40000, 50000]
+        with patch(
+            "sglang.srt.disaggregation.mooncake.conn.get_memory",
+            return_value=SimpleNamespace(enable_unified_memory=False),
+        ):
+            status = manager.send_kvcache(
+                mooncake_session_id="session",
+                prefill_kv_indices=np.array([1, 2], dtype=np.int32),
+                dst_kv_ptrs=dst_ptrs,
+                dst_kv_indices=np.array([7, 8], dtype=np.int32),
+                dst_device_kv_indices=np.array([21, 22], dtype=np.int32),
+                executor=None,
+                dst_num_draft_entries=1,
+            )
+
+        self.assertEqual(status, 0)
+        blocks = manager._transfer_data.call_args.args[1]
+        self.assertEqual(
+            blocks,
+            [
+                (1100, 10000 + 700, 200),
+                (2100, 20000 + 700, 200),
+            ],
+        )
+
+    def test_non_last_pp_stage_without_peer_count_still_rejected(self):
+        """A pre-field peer leaves the boundary unknown; keep the loud error."""
+        manager = object.__new__(MooncakeKVManager)
+        manager.kv_args = SimpleNamespace(
+            mla_compression_ratios=None,
+            prefill_start_layer=0,
+            prefill_end_layer=2,
+            kv_data_ptrs=[1000, 2000],
+            kv_item_lens=[100, 100],
+            kv_layer_ids=[],
+            num_draft_entries=0,
+        )
+        manager.is_mla_backend = True
+        manager.is_hybrid_mla_backend = False
+        manager.enable_custom_mem_pool = False
+        manager.max_transfer_batch_indices = 0
+        manager.pp_size = 2
+        with patch(
+            "sglang.srt.disaggregation.mooncake.conn.get_memory",
+            return_value=SimpleNamespace(enable_unified_memory=False),
+        ):
+            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "device-only"):
+                manager.send_kvcache(
+                    mooncake_session_id="session",
+                    prefill_kv_indices=np.array([1, 2], dtype=np.int32),
+                    dst_kv_ptrs=[10000, 20000, 30000, 40000, 50000],
+                    dst_kv_indices=np.array([7, 8], dtype=np.int32),
+                    dst_device_kv_indices=np.array([21, 22], dtype=np.int32),
+                    executor=None,
+                )
+
+
+class TestMooncakeRegistrationDraftCount(CustomTestCase):
+    """The decode's registration carries its draft-entry count so a PP>1
+    prefill stage without a draft runner can locate the device-only suffix."""
+
+    def _manager(self, num_draft_entries):
+        manager = object.__new__(MooncakeKVManager)
+        manager.kv_args = SimpleNamespace(
+            kv_data_ptrs=[0x1000, 0x2000],
+            aux_data_ptrs=[0x3000],
+            aux_item_lens=[],
+            state_data_ptrs=[[0x4000]],
+            state_item_lens=[[8]],
+            state_dim_per_tensor=[[1]],
+            state_layer_ids=[[0]],
+            kv_layer_ids=[0, 1],
+            engine_rank=0,
+            kv_item_lens=[64, 64],
+            num_draft_entries=num_draft_entries,
+        )
+        manager.attn_tp_size = 1
+        manager.dcp_size = 1
+        manager.dcp_rank = 0
+        manager.enable_staging = False
+        manager.customized_info_enabled = False
+        manager.local_ip = "127.0.0.1"
+        manager.rank_port = 1234
+        manager.get_session_id = lambda: "session"
+        return manager
+
+    def test_registration_carries_draft_entry_count(self):
+        msg = self._manager(2).build_receiver_registration_message()
+
+        info = KVArgsRegisterInfo.from_zmq(msg)
+
+        self.assertEqual(info.num_draft_entries, 2)
+        self.assertEqual(info.dst_kv_ptrs, [0x1000, 0x2000])
+
+    def test_registration_without_the_field_parses_none(self):
+        msg = self._manager(2).build_receiver_registration_message()[:-1]
+
+        info = KVArgsRegisterInfo.from_zmq(msg)
+
+        self.assertIsNone(info.num_draft_entries)
+
+    def test_zero_draft_entries_round_trips(self):
+        msg = self._manager(0).build_receiver_registration_message()
+
+        info = KVArgsRegisterInfo.from_zmq(msg)
+
+        self.assertEqual(info.num_draft_entries, 0)
+
